help: Yearly inputs that no free daily feed supplies. Edit a value here and commit it; the next update uses it. Keep as_of and source accurate, because the page shows them.

flow.unit: billion tonnes of CO2 a year

policy.source: Climate Action Tracker, warming under current policies (COP31 update)
policy.rule: A score of 0 means on track for 1.5 °C of warming by 2100. A score of 100 means on track for 3.6 °C, where current policies pointed in 2015.
